title: My Instagram runs itself
caption:
I was asleep. My reel still went live at 7:30 PM 😴🚀

No team. No editor. It's just Claude 🤖
Comment anything and I'll DM you how we built it 📩
tip: Any comment → DM with the p/autopilot guide (follow gate on). Keep #justclaude in the caption.
